description: Check transfer and one-way playlist-sync capabilities between two exact public platform slugs, such as spotify and youtube-music. Return supported item types and human-readable web guide URLs from the cached Soundiiz capability catalog. Show the exact returned guideUrl links, including query parameters, to users. This does not check account eligibility or live status. Import corenames can differ from public slugs.

destination.description: Exact destination public slug, for example youtube-music rather than import corename ytmusic.

source.description: Exact source slug from https://soundiiz.com/capabilities.json; not a URL.

name: getSoundiizTransferCompatibility

generatedAt.description: Generation time of the cached capability snapshot in UTC.

guideUrl.description: Public web guide to show as a clickable link to the user; null when no guide is published.
Public web guide to show as a clickable link to the user; null when no guide is published.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status associated with this tool error.

retryAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying.
